lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army while increasing economy and expansions. Maintain current defense and technology development.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to a single attack without scouting, neglecting anti-air, or over-investing in ground without flexibility.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of an air transition or heavy pressure.
lessons.title: Avoid over-committing to a single attack without scouting
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 4 minutes, both sides have heavy economy and production, opponent likely ground with Zealots/Stalkers, you have Marines/Marauders.
lessons.why: Both sides are in a macro-oriented phase. Maintaining a strong economy and production allows you to out-scale the opponent if they commit to a ground composition.

lessons.correction: Increase your production and continue developing your ground army. Maintain your economy and technology development.
lessons.mistake: Over-extending your economy without sufficient army, or neglecting scouting to identify opponent's tech path.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of an air transition or heavy pressure.
lessons.title: Avoid over-extending economy without sufficient army
lessons.when: Early game, around 3 minutes, you have ground army of Marines/Marauders, heavy economy, opponent posture unknown but heavy economy.
lessons.why: With a ground army already established, it is efficient to continue producing units and expanding your economy to support a strong mid-game.

lessons.correction: Maintain your ground army while considering adding anti-air capabilities. Continue developing your economy and technology.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting your ground army in favor of anti-air, or being caught off guard by Oracle harassment.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent commits more heavily to air or if they switch back to ground.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting anti-air against air transition
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 5 minutes, opponent has transitioned to air with Oracles/Zealots, you have ground army with Marines/Marauders.
lessons.why: The opponent's air presence requires you to prepare for potential Oracle harassment or a transition to a more air-heavy composition.
